reviews.conclusion: Portal transitions, repeated settings changes, and narrow/obscured game captures occur within the long bracket. Visible menus alone are approximately 2.5-4.5 s; obscured intervals prevent exact accounting of the -4.9465 s deficit. Inventory and normal portal animation are not treated as pauses.
Stronghold portal exit shows loading followed by video/options settings, then another brief options sample. Visible menu time is approximately 0.75-1.75 s, compatible with the -1.3193 s deficit.
A visible pause/settings visit spans approximately1.0-1.5 s, compatible with the1.2918 s deficit. A death/respawn and portal loading also occur; neither is automatically counted as a GUI-clock pause.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
